noInherit.description: If true, the annotation is not inherited by mixins.

title:
This is the base type for all annotations. Annotations are defined as inner types of {@link Ann}, such as
{@link Ann.Db} and used without that prefix and with the first letter lower-cased: `@db`.

If the annotation is used without any arguments, it indicates a _marker_ annotation.

One or more fields can be specified in parenthesis: `@db(shortId=true, shortIdPrefix='x_')`.

For annotations that define a field name "_value_" or use the `@annotation(value=true)` on one of their fields,
the shortcut, value-only syntax may also be used: `@xyz(`_value_`)`.

@see Annotatable
@see Ann.Annotation
name: Annotation
